title: Retargeting Video Ad Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Make a retargeting video ad from one product photo. Show a useful return-to-product moment, then set your audience, offer, and frequency in your ad platform.
h1: Retargeting Video Ads for a Second Look
lead: Retargeting video ad creatives give a shopper a useful second look at a product. Upload a photo, describe a short return-to-product moment, and get a clip; the ad platform still controls who sees it.
intro: The sample shows an adult commuter using dark navy over-ear headphones during a train-station routine. It is an AI-generated scene, not a claim about an individual shopper or their past activity.
Pair a useful product reminder with an audience, offer, and frequency you configure in your ad platform. The scene itself does not identify visitors or cart activity.
tip: Describe a quiet second-look action and leave the audience, price, and reminder wording to the ad platform and your editor.

steps.d: Upload a clear product image that gives the clip a recognizable shape and useful detail.
Write a moment such as inspecting the ear cups and placing the headphones into a commuter bag.
Add your offer and product page, then choose visitors, cart users, exclusions, and frequency in your ad platform.

ideas.d: Use one close action to bring a useful product detail back into view.
Show a product going into a bag, case, or drawer to suggest a next step without a promise.
Make another run that shows the same product from a different useful angle.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC choose my retargeting audience?
faq.a: No. Set visitors, cart users, exclusions, budget, frequency, and delivery in your ad platform.

faq.q: Can the video claim that someone viewed or abandoned a cart?
faq.a: Do not make that claim in the generated scene. It does not know a viewer’s history. Add only text that matches your actual campaign and data.

faq.q: Will it add the offer or price?
faq.a: No. Add the current offer, price, dates, and disclosure in your editor or ad platform.

overview.d: A short product reminder can show how an item fits a routine, explain one detail, or make a practical comparison easy to see.

overview.h2: Set the offer in your platform
overview.d: Add the current price, offer, audience, and frequency in your advertising platform before launch.

input_guide.h2: Choose a product detail worth revisiting

items.d: Use a photo where the product shape is clear before the second-look action begins.
A turn, close, lace, click, or pack-away motion gives the reminder a concrete reason to exist.
Show the sole, ear cup, wheel, clasp, or pocket that a shopper may want to inspect again.
Use a clean source photo and add the current price or promotion only after the clip is reviewed.

results.h2: What the reminder asset can provide

items.d: The clip returns to a practical detail or use moment without claiming anything about a particular shopper.
Choose 1:1 for a feed, 9:16 for Reels, or 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 when another placement requires it.
Six seconds uses 24 credits, ten 40, fifteen 60, and thirty 120; the charge is shown before you make the asset.

after_download.h2: Set the retargeting message in your ad platform

fit.h2: A good fit for a reminder ad

Offers that the seller controls outside the asset
not_ideal: A campaign that needs automatic inventory or cart data inside the clip

steps.sourceAlt: Dark navy over-ear headphones with padded ear cups on a pale background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the complete headband and both ear cups in clear focus.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult commuter wearing the over-ear headphones walks along a bright station platform and turns toward an arriving train, both ear cups visible. Soft daylight, candid phone-video look. Medium side-follow framing with one smooth handheld move. End side-on at the station with both ear cups visible. Sound: footsteps and low station ambience; no music.
